annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Transport, Singapore (Second Minister for Transport Ng Chee Meng)
key_provisions_or_claims: Clause 6 lets the Minister make rules regulating AV trials and use on public roads, covering SAE J3016 levels 3-5.
Rules may set time and space limits, equipment design standards and data-sharing requirements for trials.
Rules may exempt AVs and their operators from, or modify, provisions that assume a human driver.
The AV regulatory sandbox is limited to five years, after which permanent legislation or an extension will be considered.
Private hire car drivers will need vocational licences, and booking operators such as Uber and Grab take on enforcement duties and face suspension orders.
annotation.summary_en: Opening speech at the Second Reading of Singapore's Road Traffic (Amendment) Bill 2017. It sets out a light-touch, balanced approach: a five-year regulatory sandbox letting the Minister make rules for autonomous vehicle trials (SAE levels 3-5), plus stricter private hire car licensing, operator duties and higher penalties.
